answer_1.quote: We introduce CoTA, a large-scale dataset containing 1.2 million refined captions and question-answer (QA) pairs. CoTA spans multiple datasets and tasks, undergoing rigorous filtering to ensure diversity and quality.
answer_1.outputs: structured CoT reasoning with length could more than exceeding 1K tokens in real-world tasks

answer_2.quote: We first measure accuracy on closed-form questions using the MMAU-mini subset , because the model was not trained on multiple-choice data. We then assess real-world conversational ability via the chat and foundation sections of AIR-Bench , covering sound, speech, and music modalities. We also evaluate speech-to-text translation on CoVoST 2  and speech emotion recognition on MELD .
